newsitem.title: GERMANY: German BHW drops plans for Postbank stake.
newsitem.headline: German BHW drops plans for Postbank stake.

text.p: German financial services group BHW Holding AG said on Tuesday it had dropped plans to set up a product partnership with Postbank and to take a stake in the soon-to-be privatised postal bank.
In a mandatory statement, the group also said it had sold its remaining stake in DSL Holding AG, a state-controlled bank, as it no longer fufilled any strategic function.
BHW last week said it had reduced its DSL stake to around 10.5 percent from 20.69 percent.
BHW, which has long said it wanted a close co-operation with Postbank, said altered government conditions with regard to such a partnership made the prospect of taking a stake in the bank unviable.
A stake in Postbank, in light of its own earnings goals, would not be in the interest of its shareholders, BHW said.
With regard to the stake in DSL, the Deutsche Siedlungs- und Landesrentenbank, BHW noted that current market conditions made a sale of the shares attractive.
